events.title: Tupac Shakur shot dead
events.blurb: On September 7, 1996, American rapper Tupac Shakur was shot in a drive-by shooting in Las Vegas, Nevada, and died from his injuries six days later on September 13, 1996.

angles.name: Remembering Tupac
angles.copy: Thirty years since the tragic passing of a hip-hop icon. Tupac Shakur's music and message continue to resonate. What's your favourite track from his incredible legacy?

events.title: Jimi Hendrix death anniversary
events.blurb: Jimi Hendrix died on September 18, 1970, at the age of 27.

angles.name: Guitar Legend Remembered
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled genius of Jimi Hendrix, who left us far too soon. His influence on guitar music is still felt today. What's your go-to Hendrix track?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', was released in the UK on September 26, 1969, and in the US on October 1, 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles walked across *that* zebra crossing. 'Abbey Road' remains a masterpiece. What's your favourite moment from this iconic album?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, was born on September 7, 1951, and turns 75 today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie Hynde
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Her distinctive voice and rock 'n' roll attitude have given us so many anthems. What's your top Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the iconic frontman of Oasis, was born on September 21, 1972, and turns 54 today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam Gallagher
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! From Oasis anthems to his solo hits, he's still got that rock star swagger. What's your favourite Liam moment?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' album anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's second solo studio album, 'Imagine', was released in the UK on October 8, 1971, and in the US on September 9, 1971.

angles.name: Imagine Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. The album remains a powerful call for peace and unity. Which track from 'Imagine' resonates most with you?

events.title: First iPod released
events.blurb: Apple released the first iPod on October 23, 2001.

angles.name: iPod's 25th Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember when this changed everything? The iPod turns 25 this month, revolutionising how we listen to music. What was the first album you loaded onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day is celebrated annually on October 5th, marking the anniversary of the world premiere of the first James Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Happy James Bond Day
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From the gadgets to the theme tunes, 007 is always a classic. Who's your favourite Bond and what's the best Bond song?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon was born on October 9, 1940, and would have been 86 today.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the visionary John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire generations. What's your favourite Lennon song?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: John Cleese, the legendary comedian and actor, was born on October 27, 1939, and turns 87 today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the incomparable John Cleese! A true titan of British comedy, from Monty Python to Fawlty Towers. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' White Album anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago, The Beatles gave us the sprawling, eclectic 'White Album'. A true journey through their diverse sounds. What's your unexpected favourite track?

events.title: Freddie Mercury death anniversary
events.blurb: Freddie Mercury, the iconic lead singer of Queen, died on November 24, 1991.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie Mercury
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost the irreplaceable Freddie Mercury. His voice, stage presence, and songwriting changed music forever. What's your favourite Queen song?

events.title: The Beatles' Rubber Soul anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', was released in the UK on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-one years since The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' dropped, marking a pivotal shift in their sound. A truly influential album. Which track is still on your playlist?

events.title: John Lennon death anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon was shot and killed on December 8, 1980, outside his New York City residence.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago today, the world lost a musical legend. John Lennon's legacy of peace, love, and incredible music lives on. What does his work mean to you?
